dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds suspicious. What happened? Tell me the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: Alright, alright. Gah, it really does seem like I've got no talent for pulling in investors...

dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: But I really was an engineer at the Institute once, and it was my goal to use machines to pursue the apex of aesthetics.

dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: But an... accident happened, resulting in some damage to one of my colleagues' appearance.

dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: And when I returned from my stint at the Fortress of Meropide, I started living here.

dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: They told me that Fleuve Cendre was a bit of a gray area, and that I might be able to secure some funding here.

dialogues.speaker: Lelienne
dialogues.text: But as it turns out, that's not the case at all! The Spina di Rosula watches everyone here like hawks, you see...
